title: Peak hardware FLOPS vs DRAM and interconnect bandwidth growth (Gholami et al.)
conventions: Fitted rates as stated in Fig. 1 legend. Compute normalized to R10000 (1997); DRAM and interconnect series appear normalized to their own earliest point (GDDR3 / PCIe 1.0a = 1), not to R10000.

Fitted lines in Fig.1 start at about 1 (compute at R10000 1997) but DRAM/interconnect lines start at ~1.7 and ~0.9 around 2003-2004; slide plots all three from 1x at year 0 per BRIEF, which is a simplification.
